steps.title: Оконные функции и сложные JOIN
steps.content:
## Окна

`SUM() OVER (ORDER BY …)`, `FIRST_VALUE`, `ROW_NUMBER`. Для «топ-N в группе» — оконные функции или коррелированные подзапросы.

content.caption: PARTITION BY задаёт группы для окна

steps.title: 1731. The Number of Employees Which Report to Each Employee

content.description:
Для каждого менеджера (`employee_id` из `Employees`): `reports_count`, `average_age` (округлить 0 знаков) подчинённых. Только менеджеры с ≥1 подчинённым.

[LeetCode 1731](https://leetcode.com/problems/the-number-of-employees-which-report-to-each-employee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employees(employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, employee_name TEXT NOT NULL, reports_to INTEGER, age INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT employee_id, COUNT(*) FROM Employees GROUP BY reports_to;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT e.employee_id, COUNT(r.employee_id) AS reports_count, ROUND(AVG(r.age), 0) AS average_age FROM Employees e JOIN Employees r ON e.employee_id = r.reports_to GROUP BY e.employee_id ORDER BY e.employee_id;

content.description:
Для каждого сотрудника — **основной** отдел: если одна запись в `Employee` — она; если две — где `primary_flag = "Y"`. Колонки: `employee_id`, `department_id`.

[LeetCode 1789](https://leetcode.com/problems/primary-department-for-each-employee/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(employee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, primary_flag TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT employee_id, department_id FROM Employee WHERE primary_flag = "Y" OR employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM Employee GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);

content.description:
Строки `(x,y,z)`, которые могут быть сторонами **нестороннего** треугольника (сумма любых двух > третьей). Колонка `triangle` = «Yes»/«No».

[LeetCode 177](https://leetcode.com/problems/triangle-judgement/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Triangle(x INTEGER NOT NULL, y INTEGER NOT NULL, z INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT x, y, z, "No" AS triangle FROM Triangle;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT x, y, z, CASE WHEN x + y > z AND x + z > y AND y + z > x THEN "Yes" ELSE "No" END AS triangle FROM Triangle;

content.description:
Числа, встречающиеся **≥ 3 раз подряд** (по `id`). Верните `num` **без дубликатов**.

[LeetCode 180](https://leetcode.com/problems/consecutive-numbers/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Logs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, num INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT l1.num FROM Logs l1 JOIN Logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1 JOIN Logs l3 ON l2.id = l3.id - 1 WHERE l1.num = l2.num AND l2.num = l3.num;

steps.title: 1164. Product Price at a Given Date

content.description:
Цена каждого `product_id` на «2019-08-16»: последняя известная цена на эту дату или раньше. Колонка `price`.

[LeetCode 1164](https://leetcode.com/problems/product-price-at-a-given-date/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, new_price INTEGER NOT NULL, change_date TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, new_price AS price FROM Products;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT product_id, FIRST_VALUE(new_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date DESC) AS price FROM Products WHERE change_date <= "2019-08-16";

steps.title: 1204. Last Person to Fit in the Bus

content.description:
Люди садятся в автобус по `turn` по очереди; вместимость 1000 кг. Кто **последний** успел сесть? Колонка `person_name`.

[LeetCode 1204](https://leetcode.com/problems/last-person-to-fit-in-the-bus/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Queue(person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, person_name TEXT NOT NULL, weight INTEGER NOT NULL, turn INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT person_name FROM Queue ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT person_name FROM (SELECT person_name, turn, SUM(weight) OVER (ORDER BY turn) AS running FROM Queue) WHERE running <= 1000 ORDER BY turn DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Три категории окладов всех сотрудников: `Low Salary` (<20000), `Average Salary` ([20000,50000]), `High Salary` (>50000). Колонки `category`, `accounts_count` (0 если никого).

[LeetCode 1907](https://leetcode.com/problems/count-salary-categories/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Accounts(account_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, income INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT "Low Salary" AS category, COUNT(*) FROM Accounts;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT category, COUNT(a.income) AS accounts_count FROM (SELECT "Low Salary" AS category UNION SELECT "Average Salary" UNION SELECT "High Salary") c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON (c.category = "Low Salary" AND a.income < 20000) OR (c.category = "Average Salary" AND a.income BETWEEN 20000 AND 50000) OR (c.category = "High Salary" AND a.income > 50000) GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
